description: Labour hours from the emailed time sheets are department and week totals only, marked hr. A reader sees them (the Labour page, the overtime alert, labour answers) only when holding one of these grants. The owner assigns principals in the host's grants file named by PLX_LABOUR_GRANTS_FILE ({"hr": ["user:<oid>"], "ops-management": [...]}); these definitions grant nobody.

grants.description: People and HR staff: department and week labour hours, overtime and headcount-days.
Operations and plant management: the same labour aggregates, for staffing and overtime decisions.
